challenge.name: Full wine glass
challenge.description: Almost every wine photo in training data shows a glass a third full, so models default to it. Filling the glass to the rim tests whether a model follows the prompt or the prior.

variants.name: Full wine glass
variants.prompt: A wine glass filled to the brim with white wine, the surface level with the rim of the glass, standing upright on a plain wooden table. Straight-on eye-level shot, glass upright and not tilted, no other objects in the frame.

challenge.name: Closed umbrellas
challenge.description: Rain and umbrellas are so tightly linked in training data that models open the umbrellas on their own. Twelve closed umbrellas in a downpour tests whether the prompt beats the association, and lets us check per-person counting at the same time.

variants.name: Closed umbrellas
variants.prompt: Wide street-level photograph of about twelve people crossing a city street in heavy rain. Every person is carrying a closed, furled umbrella held down at their side. Not a single umbrella is open. Each umbrella is clearly visible. They are all getting soaked. No other people in the frame.

challenge.name: Three fingers
challenge.description: Hands are the classic failure case for image models. Asking for exactly three fingers up and two folded makes both the count and the anatomy easy to check at a glance.

variants.name: Three fingers
variants.prompt: Close straight-on photograph of an open right hand raised palm towards the camera, with exactly three fingers extended straight up and the other two folded down into the palm. Plain background, nothing else in the frame.

challenge.name: Cards & dice
challenge.description: Small counts with specific values in a fixed order. Each card face and die pip is a separate, unambiguous check, so this exposes counting and ordering failures that a vaguer scene would hide.

variants.name: Cards
variants.prompt: Exactly four playing cards face up in a single straight row on a polished marble counter, evenly spaced, all the same size, showing the seven of hearts, the eight of spades, the nine of diamonds and the ten of clubs from left to right. No other objects in the frame. Straight-on eye-level shot, soft even light.

variants.name: Dice
variants.prompt: Exactly five white six-sided dice in a single straight row on a polished marble counter, evenly spaced, all the same size, showing one, two, three, four and five pips from left to right. No other objects in the frame. Straight-on eye-level shot, soft even light.

challenge.name: Long exact string
challenge.description: A single long line of text with numbers, a percent sign and a date. One wrong or missing character fails it, so this measures exact text rendering rather than text that merely looks plausible.

variants.name: Long exact string
variants.prompt: A white A4 poster on a brick wall reading exactly "SPRING CLEARANCE - EVERYTHING 40% OFF - SATURDAY 14 JUNE, 9AM TO 6PM". No other text in the frame.

challenge.name: Multiple languages
challenge.description: Four scripts on four lines in a fixed order. Models trained mostly on Latin text often garble Japanese, Korean and Arabic or shuffle the order, and the sign format makes each line easy to verify.

variants.name: Multiple languages
variants.prompt: Straight-on photograph of a white overhead directional sign in an international airport terminal, with a black arrow pointing right at the left end. The sign carries the same word in four scripts on four stacked lines, in this order from top to bottom: "DEPARTURES", then the Japanese 出発, then the Korean 출발, then the Arabic المغادرة. Clean sans-serif lettering, sharp focus, no other text anywhere in the frame.

challenge.name: Occlusion
challenge.description: Two objects with a stated depth order and a stated direction of overlap. Models often place things side by side or reverse which object hides which, so this checks whether the model builds a real spatial layout.

variants.name: Occlusion
variants.prompt: Straight-on eye-level photograph of a plain wooden desk. On the left, a closed hardcover book with a dark red cover stands upright, its front cover facing the camera. A blue ceramic mug stands on the desk to the right of the book and clearly further back, about 20 cm behind it, positioned so that the right edge of the book overlaps and hides the left third of the mug. The mug's handle points to the right and the whole rim of the mug is visible. Bare desk surface is visible between the book and the mug. Nothing else on the desk. Plain wall behind, soft even light.

challenge.name: Mirror
challenge.description: Reflections have to be mirrored, not copied, and have to match the objects on the counter. Getting both right requires a consistent scene, which many models fake with a second copy of the objects.

variants.name: Mirror
variants.prompt: Straight-on eye-level photograph of a bathroom vanity. A large rectangular mirror covers the wall behind the counter and its bottom edge meets the countertop, so both the objects and their reflections are visible. On the counter, a tall red toothbrush cup on the left and a tall green glass bottle on the right, both roughly 20 cm tall and well apart from each other. The mirror reflects the counter and the objects on it accurately. Nothing else in the frame.

challenge.name: Plain zebra
challenge.description: Every zebra the model has ever seen has stripes. Asking for a stripeless zebra that is still recognizably a zebra tests whether it can hold the concept while removing its defining feature.

variants.name: Plain zebra
variants.prompt: Photograph of a zebra standing side-on in short grass. Its coat is a uniform solid grey with no stripes, no bands and no markings of any kind anywhere on its body. The whole animal is visible. Sharp focus.

challenge.name: Times Square
challenge.description: Times Square is defined by text and logos. Asking for the same place with every screen blank but still lit tests negation at scale, since a single stray letter fails it.

variants.name: Times Square
variants.prompt: Wide street-level photograph of Times Square in New York at night, wet asphalt reflecting the lights. Every billboard, screen, storefront window, awning, taxi door and road marking is completely blank — lit with plain colour fields and soft gradients only. No letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no lettering of any kind anywhere in the frame. Sharp focus, straight-on shot.

challenge.name: Minimal diff
challenge.description: A one-line text edit where everything else must stay identical. This isolates whether an editing model can change the target without repainting the scene, and the exact new text is easy to check.

variants.name: Minimal diff
variants.prompt: From the reference photo, change only the sign text to "ROUTE 7 ESPRESSO - OPEN TILL 8". Keep the sign, wall, lighting and framing identical.

challenge.name: Object removal
challenge.description: Removing one of five identical cups by position tests whether the model understands the instruction spatially, removes the right one, and reconstructs the shelf behind it without touching the rest.

variants.name: Object removal
variants.prompt: Remove only the second cup from the left in the reference photo. Leave the other four cups exactly as they are, in the same positions, and leave the shelf, towel, wall, plant and lighting untouched.

challenge.name: Person removal
challenge.description: Removing a person is easy. Removing their shadow and window reflection as well, while leaving two other people untouched, is where editing models usually leave evidence behind.

variants.name: Person removal
variants.prompt: In the reference photo, remove only the person in the yellow coat. Their shadow on the pavement and their reflection in the shop window must be removed as well. Reconstruct the pavement and the window glass behind them. The person in the red coat and the person in the green coat must stay completely unchanged, including their own shadows and their own reflections. Change nothing else in the frame.

challenge.name: Product placement
challenge.description: Placing a specific product in a new setting is one of the most common real uses of reference-guided generation. Every painted detail on the mug has to survive, which exposes models that regenerate a look-alike instead of preserving the object.

variants.name: Product placement
variants.prompt: Product photograph of the ceramic mug from the reference image, standing upright on a café table. Show the same side of the mug, from the same side-on eye-level angle as the reference, with the handle on the right. The shape, proportions, colours, moulded relief and every painted detail must match the reference exactly. Only the setting and lighting change: soft daylight in a café interior, shallow depth of field.

challenge.name: Four references
challenge.description: Face, jacket, mug and scene each come from a different reference image. Combining four references into one plausible photo, three times over with different scenes, tests whether identity and objects survive together rather than one at a time.

variants.name: Desk
variants.prompt: Place the person from the portrait reference at the desk in the scene reference, wearing the rust orange canvas jacket from its reference and holding the navy blue travel mug from its reference in one hand. Keep the face, the jacket and the mug exactly as they appear in the references — same colours, same details, same proportions. Do not change the room.

variants.name: Kitchen
variants.prompt: Place the person from the portrait reference at the kitchen counter in the scene reference, wearing the rust orange canvas jacket from its reference and holding the navy blue travel mug from its reference in one hand. Keep the face, the jacket and the mug exactly as they appear in the references — same colours, same details, same proportions. Do not change the room.

variants.name: Café
variants.prompt: Place the person from the portrait reference at the café table in the scene reference, wearing the rust orange canvas jacket from its reference and holding the navy blue travel mug from its reference in one hand. Keep the face, the jacket and the mug exactly as they appear in the references — same colours, same details, same proportions. Do not change the room.

challenge.name: Portraits
challenge.description: Skin and lens realism, natural light and motion, hands and eyes.

variants.name: Studio headshot
variants.prompt: Studio headshot of a woman in a charcoal blazer against a mid-grey seamless backdrop, lit by a large softbox slightly above and to the left with a soft fill from the right, catchlights in both eyes. An 85mm look with shallow depth of field, skin texture and flyaway hairs kept rather than smoothed.

variants.name: Candid outdoors
variants.prompt: Candid photograph of a man laughing mid-conversation on a city sidewalk in late afternoon sun, hair moving in the wind, one hand raised mid-gesture. Backlit with the lens flare kept in frame, background traffic softly out of focus, natural skin tones.

variants.name: Close-up detail
variants.prompt: Photograph of an elderly luthier holding a half-finished violin body up to a workshop window to check its line, both hands in sharp focus, wood dust suspended in the light. Weathered skin and worn fingernails visible, soft directional daylight from one side, the workbench dark behind.

challenge.name: People in scenes
challenge.description: Multiple faces, counting, and limbs mid-action.

variants.name: Team at work
variants.prompt: Photograph of four cooks working the pass in a restaurant kitchen at service, plating three dishes at once, several hands in frame and some of them overlapping. One cook partly hidden behind another, steam rising into hard overhead light, each face clearly a different person.

variants.name: Street crowd
variants.prompt: Photograph of a busy pedestrian crossing at midday, roughly twenty people walking in both directions, each face clearly a different person, some looking at phones and some talking. Shot from the far kerb at eye level, sharp from front to back, ordinary daylight.

variants.name: Sport in motion
variants.prompt: Photograph of a basketball game in a public park at the moment of a layup, one player in the air with the ball leaving the fingertips, two defenders with arms up, feet visibly off the ground. Fast shutter freezing every limb, long shadows, chain-link fence behind.

challenge.name: Animals
challenge.description: Fur, anatomy and fine detail.

variants.name: Pet at home
variants.prompt: Photograph of a tabby cat asleep on a sunlit windowsill, fur lit from behind so the individual hairs glow at the edges, one ear turned toward the camera. Shallow depth of field, a houseplant soft in the background, quiet morning light.

variants.name: Wildlife
variants.prompt: Wildlife photograph of a red fox pausing in long grass at dawn, mid-step with one forepaw raised, looking directly at the camera. Dew on the grass, low warm backlight through the coat, long lens compression with the treeline soft behind.

variants.name: Macro insect
variants.prompt: Macro photograph of a honeybee on a lavender flower, the compound eyes and the individual hairs on the thorax in focus, pollen grains visible on the legs. Diffused light, soft purple and green bokeh, no motion blur.

challenge.name: Landscape & nature
challenge.description: Foliage density, water and reflections, empty composition, and scale.

variants.name: Forest
variants.prompt: Photograph of an old-growth temperate rainforest after rain, moss on every trunk and fallen log, ferns dense across the floor, thin fog between the far trees. Overcast light with no direct sun, everything from the nearest fern to the last trunk in focus.

variants.name: Coast
variants.prompt: Photograph of a tidal rock pool at low light, anemones open underwater, wet granite crusted with barnacles and weed around the rim, the horizon and breaking surf soft and far out of focus behind. Overcast daylight with no direct sun, macro depth of field.

variants.name: Desert
variants.prompt: Photograph of an empty sand desert an hour before sunset, one long dune ridge running diagonally through the frame with a razor line between the lit and shadowed faces, wind ripples in the foreground sand. No people, no vehicles, no plants. Clear sky fading from pale gold to blue.

variants.name: Mountains
variants.prompt: Photograph of a glacial valley from a high ridge, snow-capped peaks along the skyline, a braided river flat on the valley floor far below, a single tiny hut for scale. Crisp morning air, clouds casting shadows across the slopes, sharp to the horizon.

challenge.name: Interiors
challenge.description: Straight lines, materials and believable clutter.

variants.name: Living room
variants.prompt: Photograph of a lived-in living room in mid-morning light, a linen sofa with a thrown blanket, a stack of books and a half-finished mug on the coffee table, a rug slightly askew. Wide angle from standing height, verticals kept straight, light from a large window on the left.

variants.name: Kitchen
variants.prompt: Photograph of a home kitchen mid-cooking, a pan on the hob with steam rising, chopped vegetables on a wooden board, a tea towel over the oven handle and one cupboard door left open. Natural light from a window over the sink, straight verticals, wide angle.

variants.name: Office
variants.prompt: Photograph of a small open-plan office at the end of the day, three desks with monitors still on, a jacket over one chair, cables and a water bottle on the nearest desk, blinds half drawn. Wide angle from standing height, ceiling panels above and evening light from the window.

variants.name: Library
variants.prompt: Photograph of a long library reading room in late afternoon, low sun raking down one wall of shelves so the light falls off sharply toward the far end, dust visible in the beam. One reader at the nearest table. Wide angle from standing height, verticals kept straight.

challenge.name: Food & drink
challenge.description: Texture and appetite, glass and liquid, repetition.

variants.name: Plated dish
variants.prompt: Photograph of a plated seared salmon fillet on a white ceramic plate, crisp skin facing up, a spoon of herb sauce dragged across the plate, a few microgreens. Three-quarter view from above, soft daylight from the side, the flakes of the fish visible where the fillet is cut.

variants.name: Cocktail
variants.prompt: Photograph of a negroni in a heavy rocks glass over one large clear ice cube, an orange peel twist on the rim, condensation on the outside of the glass. Bar top with a dark background, one warm light from the side catching the colour of the liquid, shallow depth of field.

variants.name: Bakery
variants.prompt: Close-up photograph of a sourdough loaf torn open by hand, steam still coming off the crumb, the open structure irregular with a glossy interior and a dark blistered crust. Side light from a window, flour on the board, shallow depth of field.

variants.name: Espresso pour
variants.prompt: Close-up photograph of espresso falling from a portafilter into a clear glass cup on a marble counter, the crema breaking into ribbons as it lands, a single droplet suspended in mid-air above the surface. Strong backlight through the glass, condensation beading on the outside, shallow depth of field.

challenge.name: Product shots
challenge.description: Gloss and labels, thin bezels, fabric on a body, box text.

variants.name: Cosmetics
variants.prompt: Photograph of a small unbranded amber glass bottle with a black dropper cap on a pale seamless studio sweep, lit by one large softbox from the left with a black card on the right holding the edge. The glass reads amber through its full depth, one soft highlight down the shoulder, contact shadow tight beneath the base.

variants.name: Electronics
variants.prompt: Product photograph of an unbranded pair of over-ear wireless headphones standing on a matte black surface, the matte plastic and the brushed aluminium reading as different materials, a thin seam line around each ear cup. One large softbox above, a rim light on the headband, no text anywhere.

variants.name: Apparel
variants.prompt: Photograph of a person wearing an unbranded olive cotton overshirt, framed from the shoulders to the hips against a plain warm-grey backdrop, hands in the pockets so the fabric pulls and creases naturally. Buttons and stitching visible, soft even studio light, no visible logos.

variants.name: Packaged good
variants.prompt: Product photograph of a cardboard cereal box with the word GRANOLA printed large across the front panel in a clean sans serif, standing on a pale wooden table beside a bowl. Front three-quarter view, soft window light, the box edges crisp and the printed text sharp.

challenge.name: Cities & streets
challenge.description: Neon and signage, geometry at scale, famous-place fidelity.

variants.name: Night street
variants.prompt: Photograph of a narrow city street at night in the rain, neon signs in several colours reflected in the wet asphalt, one pedestrian under an umbrella walking away from the camera, the tail lights of a taxi streaking. Handheld look, some lens flare, the lettering on the signs legible.

variants.name: Skyline
variants.prompt: Photograph of a dense city skyline at dusk from across the water, dozens of towers with their windows lit in a mix of warm and cool, the skyline reflected and broken in the water below. Long exposure, no boats, every vertical edge of the towers straight.

variants.name: Landmark
variants.prompt: Photograph of the Eiffel Tower from across the river at sunrise, the ironwork lattice resolved clearly against a pale pink sky, the riverbank empty and wet from overnight rain. Wide angle, the tower centred and complete from base to tip.

challenge.name: Vehicles
challenge.description: Reflective bodywork and mechanical plausibility.

variants.name: Car
variants.prompt: Photograph of an unbranded dark green sports coupe parked on a wet mountain road at golden hour, the bodywork reflecting the sky and the trees in long clean highlights, brake discs visible through the wheel spokes. Three-quarter front view from a low angle, no visible badges or number plate text.

variants.name: Motorcycle
variants.prompt: Photograph of an unbranded cafe racer motorcycle on a concrete floor in an empty garage, chrome exhaust and a brushed aluminium tank, the chain, sprocket and brake lines mechanically plausible and in focus. Side-on view, one skylight overhead, no badges.

variants.name: Aircraft
variants.prompt: Photograph of a small propeller aircraft parked on a grass airstrip in early morning mist, the polished aluminium fuselage reflecting the sunrise, propeller blades still, the wing struts and control surfaces where they should be. Low three-quarter view, no markings or registration text.

challenge.name: Anime & manga
challenge.description: Line quality, painted backgrounds, dynamic pose.

variants.name: Character portrait
variants.prompt: Anime illustration, clean cel shading and crisp linework. A pilot pulling her helmet off after a hard landing, hair in disarray with one strand fallen across the eye, a hard-edged cel shadow under the jaw and along the neck. Flight suit collar open, hangar lighting from above, expression tired rather than triumphant.

variants.name: Background scene
variants.prompt: Anime illustration, clean cel shading and crisp linework. A cedar forest at the height of summer, shafts of light cutting through the canopy as hard-edged beams with dust and pollen suspended in them, one small figure standing at the base of a vast trunk for scale. Saturated greens, lens flare drawn as overlapping shapes.

variants.name: Action panel
variants.prompt: Anime illustration, clean cel shading and crisp linework. A competitive swimmer in a racing cap and goggles surfacing at the moment of the breath, mouth open, a sheet of water peeling off the shoulders and breaking into beads across the face. Chlorine-blue light from below, hard specular highlights drawn as shapes rather than gradients.

variants.name: Interior scene
variants.prompt: Anime illustration, clean cel shading and crisp linework. An empty classroom at dusk, desks in rows, orange light coming through the windows as hard-edged parallelograms across the floor and up the far wall. A curtain lifted by the breeze, chalk dust suspended in the light, the corridor beyond the door left dark.

challenge.name: Flat vector
challenge.description: Clean edges, perspective discipline, set consistency, die-cut outline.

variants.name: Spot illustration
variants.prompt: Flat vector illustration, bold two-colour poster style. A cocktail being poured into a wide glass, the liquid rendered as one continuous flat shape with no gradients, the ice cubes cut out of it as negative space. Hard geometric edges, the splash simplified to three separate shapes.

variants.name: Isometric scene
variants.prompt: Flat vector illustration, bold two-colour poster style. A one-room workshop drawn in isometric projection with no vanishing point, every edge parallel, depth coming only from which shape overlaps which. Bench, shelf and window reduced to flat rectangles, no gradients, one flat floor.

variants.name: Icon set
variants.prompt: Flat vector illustration, bold two-colour poster style. A set of nine icons on a three by three grid for a weather app: sun, cloud, rain, snow, wind, fog, thunderstorm, sunrise and moon, all drawn at the same stroke weight and the same optical size, sharing one corner radius. Clean edges, no gradients, one flat background.

variants.name: Stickers
variants.prompt: Flat vector illustration, bold two-colour poster style. A sheet of six die-cut stickers of breakfast foods, each with a thick white outline offset evenly around its silhouette and a slight drop shadow under each sticker so the sheet reads as printed. No gradients, consistent line weight across the set.

variants.name: Portrait
variants.prompt: Flat vector illustration, bold two-colour poster style. A stonemason at the bench, head and shoulders in three-quarter view, the face built from four flat shapes where the cheekbone and jaw are nothing but the boundary between two colours. No gradients, no outlines and no drawn features — the eye is a single notch of negative space.

challenge.name: 3D render
challenge.description: Stylized appeal, studio materials, depth and lighting.

variants.name: Stylized character
variants.prompt: 3D render, physically based materials, soft studio lighting. A stylised clay figurine of a violinist mid-phrase standing on a turntable, matte vinyl and clay materials with visible thumbprints pressed into the surface, features simplified with no attempt at realism. Soft studio key from the left, seamless pale backdrop.

variants.name: Product viz
variants.prompt: 3D render, physically based materials, soft studio lighting. An unbranded chrome and frosted-glass atomiser on a dark rotating base, the polished collar reflecting a rectangular softbox and the frosted body reading as rough glass rather than plastic. Three-quarter view, soft gradient backdrop, no text anywhere.

variants.name: Environment
variants.prompt: 3D render, physically based materials, soft studio lighting. An unfurnished concrete stairwell lit by a single skylight, board-formed concrete and a brushed steel handrail, soft global illumination bouncing off the walls and contact shadows tight where each tread meets the wall. Wide vertical view, no decoration.

variants.name: Material study
variants.prompt: 3D render, physically based materials, soft studio lighting. A single water droplet resting on a brushed aluminium surface, magnified, with visible caustics thrown onto the metal beneath it and the brushed grain refracted through the drop. Shallow depth of field, black background.

challenge.name: Painting & fine art
challenge.description: Brushwork, bleed and paper, economy of line.

variants.name: Oil
variants.prompt: Oil painting on canvas, thick impasto brushwork visible in raking light. A harbour at the end of the day, fishing boats with their hulls built from a few loaded strokes, the water a broken surface of short horizontal marks, the sky knifed on in pale layers. Edges lost where warm meets warm, the canvas weave showing through in the thinnest passages.

variants.name: Watercolor
variants.prompt: Loose watercolor painting on textured paper, visible brush edges. Rain falling on a canal at dusk, the pigment allowed to bloom and granulate where each drop lands on the water, reflections of lit windows pulled downward in wet-on-wet streaks. Edges left unresolved, the brightest reflections reserved as bare paper.

variants.name: Ink & line
variants.prompt: Ink and line drawing on white paper, a single continuous fine pen line with no shading. A bicycle leaning against a lamppost on a quiet street, the wheels drawn as confident ellipses, the buildings behind suggested by a handful of lines and left mostly as empty paper. No hatching, no colour, no fill.

challenge.name: Concept art & fantasy
challenge.description: Original design, world scale, costume detail.

variants.name: Creature
variants.prompt: Concept art of an original creature, a six-limbed forest grazer with a moss-covered shell along its back and a long flexible neck, shown in a three-quarter pose on a neutral ground plane. Painterly digital rendering, a readable silhouette, plausible joints and weight, no text.

variants.name: Sci-fi environment
variants.prompt: Concept art of a vast vertical city built inside a canyon, bridges and cables spanning the gap between the cliff faces, tiny figures on a walkway in the foreground giving the scale, atmospheric haze deepening with distance. Painterly digital rendering, a single strong light source from above, no text.

variants.name: Fantasy character
variants.prompt: Concept art of a desert ranger character in full costume, layered linen wraps, a scaled leather pauldron on one shoulder, a curved bow and quiver, goggles pushed up on the forehead. Three-quarter standing pose on a plain ground, painterly rendering with the materials distinguished by their sheen, no text.

challenge.name: Cartoon & comics
challenge.description: Expression, panel layout with balloons, warmth.

variants.name: Cartoon character
variants.prompt: Cartoon illustration of a round orange cat with an oversized expressive face caught mid-yawn, thick clean outlines, flat colours with simple two-tone shading, a plain pastel background. Exaggerated expression, no text.

variants.name: Comic panel
variants.prompt: A single comic book panel in a classic line-and-flat-colour style: two characters at a diner counter, the one on the left leaning in with a speech balloon reading WE NEED TO TALK, the one on the right frozen mid-sip with a small sweat drop. Bold inks, halftone shading, the balloon tail pointing at the speaker.

variants.name: Children's book spread
variants.prompt: Children's book illustration in soft gouache textures: a small bear in a yellow raincoat standing in a puddle under a huge umbrella, ducks paddling around its boots, warm evening light, rounded shapes and gentle colours. No text, composed to leave open space along the top edge.

challenge.name: Pixel & retro
challenge.description: Grid honesty and a limited palette.

variants.name: Sprite
variants.prompt: Pixel art sprite of a knight character on a plain single-colour background, a 32 by 32 pixel grid scaled up with hard square pixels and no anti-aliasing, a limited palette of eight colours, a black outline, idle standing pose facing right.

variants.name: Tileset scene
variants.prompt: Pixel art scene built from a visible 16 pixel tile grid: a village street with a well, two cottages, a fence and a tree, viewed from a three-quarter top-down angle, a sixteen-colour palette, hard pixels with no anti-aliasing or blur, the tiles repeating cleanly.

variants.name: 8-bit portrait
variants.prompt: 8-bit style pixel art portrait of a woman with short dark hair in a green jacket, drawn on a 64 by 64 grid scaled up with crisp square pixels, four colours per region and no gradients, a plain single-colour background.

challenge.name: Style switching
challenge.description: One fixed scene. The only row where the pills are styles: how faithfully a model changes its look on command.

variants.name: Photo
variants.prompt: Photograph, shallow depth of field. A competitive swimmer in a racing cap and goggles surfacing at the moment of the breath, mouth open, a sheet of water peeling off the shoulders and breaking into beads across the face. Chlorine-blue light from below, the surface churned white where the arms enter.

variants.name: Anime
variants.prompt: Anime illustration, clean cel shading, crisp linework. A competitive swimmer in a racing cap and goggles surfacing at the moment of the breath, mouth open, a sheet of water peeling off the shoulders and breaking into beads across the face. Chlorine-blue light from below, the surface churned white where the arms enter.

variants.name: Flat vector
variants.prompt: Flat vector illustration, bold two-colour poster style, no gradients. A competitive swimmer in a racing cap and goggles surfacing at the moment of the breath, mouth open, a sheet of water peeling off the shoulders and breaking into beads across the face. Chlorine-blue light from below, the surface churned white where the arms enter.

variants.name: 3D render
variants.prompt: 3D render, physically based materials, soft studio lighting. A competitive swimmer in a racing cap and goggles surfacing at the moment of the breath, mouth open, a sheet of water peeling off the shoulders and breaking into beads across the face. Chlorine-blue light from below, the surface churned white where the arms enter.

variants.name: Watercolor
variants.prompt: Loose watercolor painting on textured paper, visible brush edges. A competitive swimmer in a racing cap and goggles surfacing at the moment of the breath, mouth open, a sheet of water peeling off the shoulders and breaking into beads across the face. Chlorine-blue light from below, the surface churned white where the arms enter.

variants.name: Oil
variants.prompt: Oil painting on canvas, thick impasto brushwork visible in raking light. A competitive swimmer in a racing cap and goggles surfacing at the moment of the breath, mouth open, a sheet of water peeling off the shoulders and breaking into beads across the face. Chlorine-blue light from below, the surface churned white where the arms enter.

variants.name: Pixel
variants.prompt: Pixel art, hard square pixels, a limited sixteen-colour palette, no anti-aliasing. A competitive swimmer in a racing cap and goggles surfacing at the moment of the breath, mouth open, a sheet of water peeling off the shoulders and breaking into beads across the face. Chlorine-blue light from below, the surface churned white where the arms enter.

challenge.name: Logos
challenge.description: Short exact text, letterform invention, symbol plus text.

variants.name: Wordmark
variants.prompt: Logo design: a wordmark for a coffee roaster called NORTHWIND, the word set in a custom heavy geometric sans with the letters spaced tightly and one distinctive ligature between the T and the H, black on white. Flat, no gradients, no icon, centred with generous margin, nothing else in the frame.

variants.name: Monogram
variants.prompt: Logo design: a monogram combining the letters A and V into a single interlocking mark, the two letters sharing one stroke, drawn with a uniform line weight, dark navy on an off-white background. Flat vector look, no gradients, no additional text, centred with generous margin.

variants.name: Emblem
variants.prompt: Logo design: a circular emblem for a mountain trail club, a simplified peak and a single pine tree inside a ring, the words RIDGE TRAIL CLUB set around the inside of the ring in a clean sans serif, two colours only, flat. No gradients, centred with generous margin, nothing else in the frame.

challenge.name: Posters & covers
challenge.description: Multi-line text hierarchy, title plus imagery, legibility at small size.

variants.name: Event poster
variants.prompt: Event poster for a jazz night, the headline MIDNIGHT SESSIONS set large at the top, the date FRIDAY 12 JUNE and the venue THE BLUE ROOM smaller beneath it, a bold flat illustration of a saxophone filling the lower half. Two-colour print look, a strong type hierarchy, every word legible.

variants.name: Book cover
variants.prompt: Front cover of a novel titled THE LONG SHORE with the author name M. R. HALE beneath it, a painted image of a lone lighthouse under a storm sky, the title set in a tall serif with generous letter spacing, a small publisher mark at the bottom. A portrait cover composed inside a square frame, all text legible.

variants.name: Social thumbnail
variants.prompt: A social media thumbnail for a cooking video, the words 15 MINUTE RAMEN in huge bold condensed type across the frame, a close-up bowl of ramen behind the text, high contrast and saturated so it reads at a small size. Text sharp and legible, no other words.

challenge.name: UI mockups
challenge.description: Real-looking components and dense small text.

variants.name: App screen
variants.prompt: A mobile app screen mockup for a habit tracker, a header reading TODAY, a list of five habits each with a checkbox, a name and a streak count, a bottom tab bar with four icons, clean modern flat design on a light background. All small text legible and real-looking, shown straight on with no device frame.

variants.name: Landing page
variants.prompt: A website landing page mockup for a note-taking app called LEDGER, a navigation bar with four links, a headline reading WRITE ONCE, FIND IT FOREVER, a short subheading, one primary button reading START FREE, and a product screenshot below. Clean modern layout, realistic spacing, all text legible.

variants.name: Device mockup
variants.prompt: A device mockup: a smartphone lying on a pale desk at a slight angle beside a notebook and a pen, the screen showing a weather app with a large temperature reading and a five-day forecast. Soft daylight, the screen content sharp and legible, the bezels thin and even.

challenge.name: Patterns & textures
challenge.description: Tileability and physical plausibility.

variants.name: Seamless pattern
variants.prompt: A seamless repeating pattern of hand-drawn citrus slices, lemons and limes on a cream background, arranged so the tile repeats without visible seams in any direction, flat colours with a light paper texture. Fills the whole frame edge to edge.

variants.name: Material texture
variants.prompt: A close-up material texture of weathered oak planks, the grain, knots and fine cracks resolved sharply, a light silver-grey patina from years outdoors, lit from a low angle so the surface relief shows. Flat frontal view filling the frame, no objects.

variants.name: Fabric print
variants.prompt: A flat lay of printed cotton fabric with a repeating block-print style floral in indigo on unbleached cloth, the weave of the fabric visible through the print, a gentle fold across one corner showing the print following the cloth. Soft daylight, fills the frame.
